RSI Buy/Sell Signals (Pinescript)
The Indian IT sector has seen a sharp correction, with nearly ₹18 lakh crore wiped out and the Nifty IT index falling significantly from its peak.
In this video, we explore the key reasons behind the decline, including FII outflows, AI-led disruption, global uncertainty, and changing business models. We also discuss why some midcap IT companies may be better positioned than large-cap players in the AI era.
Topics Covered:
Why IT stocks are falling
FII selling and currency impact
AI disruption and deflationary effects
Large Cap vs Mid Cap IT
